title: The Trademarks Office (Establishment) Order
text:
SUBSIDIARY LEGISLATION
TRADE MARKS
SECTION 3-THE TRADE MARKS OFFICE Statutory
(ESTABLISHMENT) ORDER Instrument
Order by the Minister 326 of
1968
1. This Order may be cited as the Trade Marks Office (Establishment) Title
Order.
2. The Trade Marks Office is hereby established at the place described Establishment
in the Schedule. of Trade Marks
Office

SCHEDULE
(Paragraph 2)
That part of the building known as "Kwacha
House", Cairo Road, Lusaka, set apart for the
Trade Marks Office.
